titles.romaji: Tennis no Ouji-sama OVA ANOTHER STORY II: Anotoki no Bokura Specials
titles.native: テニスの王子様 OVA ANOTHER STORYⅡ～アノトキノボクラ

description:
Two short specials included in both DVD Volumes of Tennis no Ouji-sama OVA ANOTHER STORY II: Ano Toki no Bokura.

"Toukou Tamashii" is about a social media viral video war between Eiji, Horio, and Shiraishi as they compete for the most views on videos of their friends' talents.

"Bunta no Mezame" is about Yagyuu, Yanagi, and Niou secretly following Bunta at his mysterious meet-up with a regular from another school.
